review_findings.title: Private response-size constant blocks compilation
review_findings.details: Independent cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets fails with E0603 because openai_compatible.rs imports MAX_STREAMED_RESPONSE_BYTES while ollama.rs keeps it private. Make the bound available narrowly or avoid the import without weakening the limit.
